title: Coincast
tagline: Empowering creators to deploy and distribute ERC1155 NFT collections via Farcaster Frames, leveraging multi-chain support and Farcaster's 50k+ DAU distribution layer for audience growth.
description:
Coincast is an uprising platform that empowers creators to effortlessly deploy and distribute their ERC1155 NFT collections through Farcaster Frames. By harnessing the power of Farcaster's extensive distribution layer and its thriving user base of over 50,000 daily active users (DAUs), Coincast provides creators with an unparalleled opportunity to expand their reach and grow their audience across multiple blockchain networks.

With Coincast, creators have full control over their digital assets, as they can easily deploy their own ERC1155 NFT collections using the user-friendly interface. The platform offers seamless integration with Farcaster Frames, enabling creators to distribute their NFTs directly through Farcaster's social network. This integration allows creators to tap into Farcaster's highly engaged community and leverage its viral distribution capabilities.

Coincast supports multiple blockchain networks, including Sepolia, Arbitrum Sepolia, Filecoin Calibration, Neon Devnet, and Morph Sepolia, ensuring that creators can reach a diverse audience and explore different ecosystems. It has multiple use cases: *NFT Ticketing*, *E-commerce of digital assets*, *Token gated content*, *Distribute POAPs* and much more.
how_its_made:
Coincast is built using a combination of multiple technologies to ensure a seamless and efficient experience for creators and collectors alike. The platform utilizes the ERC1155 token standard, which allows for the creation of multi-token contracts, enabling creators to deploy their NFT collections with ease.

To enable multi-chain support, Coincast has deployed contracts on several blockchain networks. The contract addresses for each network are as follows:

•⁠  ⁠Sepolia: ⁠ 0xccc8aFf496bCae6a05114dB4c27279d8b6D0942A ⁠
•⁠  ⁠Arbitrum Sepolia: ⁠ 0x6633589236aa3cc786c113a9b24d77cfb2ebf0b1 ⁠
•⁠  ⁠Filecoin Calibration: ⁠ 0xA4CCEb9e84b9682ca559AA41DB57f4BECe586dc5 ⁠
•⁠  ⁠Neon Devnet: ⁠ 0x039A8561E235cF960bfed66AAD74441E3594aBb4 ⁠
•⁠  ⁠Morph Sepolia: ⁠ 0xA4CCEb9e84b9682ca559AA41DB57f4BECe586dc5 ⁠

The integration with Farcaster Frames is achieved through Frames.js, allowing Coincast to seamlessly interact with the Farcaster. This integration enables creators to distribute their NFTs directly through Farcaster Frames, leveraging the platform's social features and viral distribution capabilities.

To ensure a user-friendly experience, Coincast features an intuitive interface built using modern web technologies via NextJS and TypeScript. The frontend communicates with the smart contracts deployed on various blockchain networks.
